name: TC-LMC-08: View All on default tab opens matching category listing
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/LatestModelsByCategory.cy.js#Homepage - LatestModelsByCategory [ta] TC-LMC-08: View All on default tab opens matching category listing
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-LMC-08
**Title:** View All on default tab opens matching category listing
**Language:** ta

**Description:**
On the default 3 Wheelers tab, click View All and confirm the user lands on the matching category listing page.

**Expected Result:**
The URL matches the View All path for 3 Wheelers (for example /en/3-wheeler in English).

**Steps:**
1. Open Latest Models by Category on the default tab
2. Click View All
3. Verify the category listing URL

steps.name: visit /ta
document
its .readyState
assert expected complete to equal complete
get body
scrollIntoView {offset: {top: -140, left: 0}}
assert expected <h2.text-lg.md:text-[21px].font-bold.tracking-[0.8px].mb-4> to exist in the DOM
find button.tab-btn

assert expected [ <button.px-3.tab-padding.tab-btn-size.md:px-4.lg:px-6.py-1.lg:py-1.5.rounded-full.font-bold.text-[12px].cursor-pointer.transition.bg-[#006db7].text-white.tabsBorder.tab-btn>, 4 more... ] to have a length of 5
